chapter: Joining Raeburn and work for other leaders
title: The dog named Forgetful
summary: The press story of his dog Forgetful was a photo-shoot invention using a friend's dog.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I don't know that tune either. "Forgetful", somebody told me--
that's a Johnny Carson lead-in--somebody told me, that you had a dog named Forgetful.

That was one of my manager's creations. He set up a picture shooting session for me and they came to my house and I was close friends with the Dead End Kids in those days and Gabe Rodell was visiting me on the day that they were shooting the pictures and Gabe came over his dog, so they put Gabe's dog into the picture with me and they said George Handy sitting at home with his dog, Forgetful.
That's the story of my dog, Forgetful.
That was a good press agent stunt, because Forgetful would be a lovely name for a puppy.
